findings.evidence: Mathlib has `smul_ball`, `smul_sphere'`, and `smul_closedBall'` over `[NormedField 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]` in `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/Ball/Pointwise.lean:79-100`, while this file fixes `variable {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]` at line 35.
findings.fix: State the base preimage and membership lemmas with `{𝕜 : Type*} [NormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]`, `c : 𝕜`, and radius `‖c‖ * r`; keep the positive-real unit specializations as derived corollaries.
findings.issue: The generic normalization and membership lemmas at lines 40, 51, 61, 66, and 72 are restricted to `[NormedSpace ℝ E]` and `c : ℝ`; this is stronger than the natural Mathlib API for scalar dilation of balls/spheres.

summary: The geometric normalization API is under-generalized: the new set-theoretic ball/closed-ball/sphere lemmas are real-scalar only even though the natural Mathlib level is arbitrary normed fields.
